name: Yes Yes Yes
description: A vegetarian restaurant with a lively bar atmosphere, a seasonally changing menu, and dishes inspired by different cuisines.

name: Mei Lin Sichuan & Vegan Restaurant
description: A Sichuan restaurant serving spicy regional dishes alongside vegan options.

name: Ravintola Nolla
description: A seasonal restaurant focused on local ingredients and a zero-waste approach, with vegetarian-friendly options.

name: Ravintola Hills Dumplings
description: A casual restaurant serving dumplings and bao, including vegetarian choices.

name: Ravintola Tandoori Villa Kalasatama
description: An Indian restaurant at Sörnäistenlaituri 3 serving lunch and dinner, with vegetarian dishes on the menu.

name: Ravintola Tandoori Villa Postipuisto
description: An Indian restaurant at Postiljooninkatu 4 serving lunch and dinner, with vegetarian options.

name: Yemeni Ravintola
description: A Yemeni restaurant serving dishes such as mandi, kabsa, falafel, and papu-yemani. The menu lists main dishes around €15–€23 and includes vegetarian choices.

name: Ravintola Savotta
description: A Finnish restaurant by Senate Square serving traditional dishes, including fish, meat, and a vegetarian country menu.

name: Ravintola Sea Horse
description: A long-running Finnish restaurant known for classics such as Baltic herring, salmon soup, and schnitzel. Its menu also includes vegan dishes such as king oyster mushroom schnitzel.

name: Farang
description: A modern Southeast Asian restaurant serving meat and seafood dishes as well as vegetarian and vegan options.

name: Ravintola Tandoori Villa Metsälä
description: An Indian restaurant at Niittyläntie 2 serving meat, seafood, and vegetarian dishes, with a lunch buffet and takeout.

name: Farouge
description: A Lebanese restaurant serving shared meze, meat, and seafood dishes, with vegan options.

name: ZhenHao DimSum
description: An authentic Hong Kong style restaurant in Taka-Töölö serving handmade dumplings, fresh noodles, and traditional dim sum dishes.

name: Luckiefun's Pasila
description: A sushi buffet in Mall of Tripla with sushi, hot Asian-style dishes, and vegetarian sushi. The listed buffet prices are €15.90 for weekday lunch and €20.90 for evenings, weekends, and public holidays.

name: Luckiefun's Sushibuffet
description: A sushi buffet at Kaivokatu 10 serving Japanese sushi and Asian dishes, with a large vegetarian sushi selection.

name: Luckiefun's Itis
description: A sushi buffet at Itäkatu 1–7 with sushi, hot Asian-inspired dishes, and vegetarian sushi.

name: Damak Restaurant
description: A Turkish restaurant at Insinöörinkatu 14 serving pizza, kebabs, grilled dishes, and salads, with vegetarian and vegan options.

name: Tandoori Flames
description: A family-owned North Indian restaurant at Mäkelänkatu 30 serving tandoori dishes, curries, and meat dishes, with vegetarian and vegan choices.

name: Ravintola Tandoori Cuisine Lehtisaari
description: An Indian restaurant at Lehtisaarentie 2a serving chicken, lamb, fish, and tandoori dishes, alongside vegetarian and vegan options.

name: Kappeli
description: A historic glass-walled landmark restaurant in Esplanade Park offering classic Finnish and Scandinavian dishes in a magnificent setting.

name: BasBas Kulma
description: A buzzing neighborhood favorite in Punavuori known for incredible small plates, phenomenal wine lists, and a lively, intimate atmosphere.

name: Forza
description: An acclaimed neighborhood pizzeria in Punavuori serving world-class Neapolitan pizzas crafted with top-tier Finnish and Italian ingredients.

name: Winest
description: A warm central bistro near Kasarmitori serving comforting Georgian classics like cheese-filled khachapuri, hearty dumplings, and unique amber wines.

name: Restaurant Grön
description: A creative Michelin-starred restaurant focusing on wild, organic, and seasonal Nordic produce with a natural philosophy.

name: Ravintola Palace
description: Finland's iconic multi-Michelin-starred restaurant on the 10th floor, blending French and Nordic techniques with harbor views.

name: Finnjävel
description: A Michelin-starred restaurant celebrating traditional Finnish cuisine elevated to world-class fine dining.

name: Café Savoy
description: An iconic historical restaurant featuring classic interior design by Alvar Aalto and legendary rooftop terrace views.

name: Gastro Cafe Kallio
description: A beloved local bistro offering French-leaning comfort dishes, incredible baking, and a wonderful weekend brunch.

name: Ravintola Kuurna
description: An intimate, candle-lit bistro near Uspenski Cathedral serving creative, seasonal European dishes.

name: Boulevard Bar & Seafood
description: A French-inspired fish and seafood bistro on Bulevardi run by top culinary talent.

name: Bistro Bardot
description: A modern French brasserie by chef Hans Välimäki offering decadent snacks and classic bistro main courses.

name: Elm
description: Mediterranean-inspired dishes served inside a gorgeous 19th-century wooden villa tucked away in a quiet park.

name: Fisken på Disken
description: Located inside Kamppi shopping center, famous for serving one of the best creamy salmon soups in town.

name: Le Coucou Vert
description: An inviting neighborhood French bistro celebrating classic bistro plates, natural wines, and friendly ambiance.

name: Ravintola Pamela
description: Modern dishes cooked over a charcoal grill with vibrant Middle Eastern flavor twists.

name: Brasa
description: A live-fire charcoal grill restaurant utilizing fresh local ingredients and pairing them with brilliant wine selections.

name: Shelter
description: A stylish restaurant housed in a historic red-brick warehouse right by the waterfront near Uspenski Cathedral.

name: Pobre
description: A fantastic Spanish-Filipino fusion gem packed with bold, unique flavors.

name: Ravintola Aleksanderplats
description: An upscale restaurant-brasserie offering exquisite multi-course lunch and dinner menus.

name: Plein
description: A refined neighborhood restaurant boasting meticulous attention to detail and freshly baked artisan breads.

name: Goose Pastabar
description: A cozy neighborhood spot serving fresh, handmade pasta dishes.

name: Daddy Green's
description: A popular casual pizzeria offering incredible sourdough pies and stellar vegan cheese choices.

name: Pho Viet
description: A bustling spot serving authentic, deeply flavorful Vietnamese pho and street-food classics at great value.

name: Noodle Master
description: Famous for hand-pulled Chinese noodles, spicy dandan bowls, and rich broths.

name: Siam Thai Modern
description: A friendly local neighborhood gem serving genuinely authentic modern Thai curries and stir-fries.

name: Vinkkeli
description: A classy wine-focused restaurant offering sophisticated, seasonally driven Nordic dishes.

name: Ravintola Lappi
description: A rustic atmospheric venue bringing the true taste of the Arctic north, reindeer specialties, and wilderness cabin vibes to central Helsinki.

name: Restaurant Merimakasiini
description: A classic retro-style seaside wooden pavilion overlooking Hietalahti bay serving fresh fish and shellfish.

name: Ventuno
description: An upscale modern Italian restaurant located in a historic stone building that once served as secret service headquarters.

name: Via Tribunali
description: Traditional Neapolitan wood-fired pizza certified by the Verace Pizza Napoletana association.

name: Café Bar No 9
description: An iconic bohemian institution since 1996 serving hearty plates, wok dishes, and burgers in a buzzy atmosphere.

name: Allas Seagrill
description: Seaside dining next to Market Square offering wonderful harbor views and fresh Nordic dishes.

name: Löyly Restaurant
description: An architectural marvel right on the Baltic shoreline serving Finnish comfort foods, burgers, and fresh local plates.

name: Finlandia Bistro
description: Located inside the iconic Alvar Aalto-designed Finlandia Hall, pairing local Finnish ingredients with Mediterranean nuances.

name: Krog Roba
description: A stylish restaurant focusing on honest Nordic flavors with clean designs and cozy lighting.

name: Ravintola Nokka
description: A strict champion of organic, traceable, and wild Finnish forest and lake ingredients housed in an old customs warehouse.

name: Olo
description: A Michelin-starred restaurant offering imaginative, playful tasting menus rooted in Scandinavian nature.

name: Demo
description: A long-standing Michelin-starred favorite providing relaxed yet exceptionally high-level fine dining.

name: Ravintola Kosmos
description: A legendary historic Helsinki dining institution operating since 1924, favored by artists, writers, and cultural icons.

name: Taquería El Rey
description: Authentic Mexican street-style tacos, freshly made salsas, and vibrant flavors.

name: Pancho Villa
description: A lively Tex-Mex and Mexican restaurant serving sizzling fajitas, burgers, burritos, and spicy wings in a casual atmosphere.

name: Levant
description: Authentic, vibrant Middle Eastern street food renowned for freshly rolled wraps, crispy falafel, homemade hummus, and generous mezze plates in a relaxed setting.

name: Elias Döner REDI
description: Berlin-style gourmet döner spot inside Mall of REDI featuring seasoned chicken and beef döner, fresh crunchy seasonal salads, homemade garlic sauces, and falafel platters.

name: Hungry Hub Vuosaari
description: Popular East Helsinki fast-casual diner known for crispy fried chicken boxes, hot wings, loaded fries, and juicy smash-style beef burgers.

name: Elias Döner Kebab Vuosaari
description: Fast-casual Berlin-style döner shop located at Kahvipavunkuja in Vuosaari, serving generous portions of shaved beef döner, crispy chicken döner, fresh salad boxes, loaded fries, and falafel.

name: Yamanoon
description: Authentic Yemeni restaurant right by Malmi station specializing in slow-cooked mandi lamb and chicken, savory aqdah, freshly baked flatbreads, and traditional sahawiq sauce.

name: Malacca Kaari
description: Authentic Malaysian restaurant located in Kauppakeskus Kaari featuring an all-day buffet and à la carte dishes like slow-cooked beef rendang, spicy laksa soup, and sambal chicken using 100% Halal meat.

name: Picnic Kaari
description: Popular Finnish fast-casual café on the 1st floor of Mall Kaari, known for freshly toasted baguettes, oven-baked hot potatoes with fillings, fresh salads, and specialty coffees.

name: Seoul Good REDI
description: Vibrant Korean buffet spot inside Mall of REDI specializing in all-you-can-eat Korean fried chicken (KFC) in assorted glazes, tteokbokki, japchae, fresh banchan salads, and house kimchi.

name: Seoul Good Itis
description: Korean fried chicken and street food buffet located on the 2nd floor in the EATIS food court of Itis shopping center, offering crispy glazed chicken, hot sides, soups, and traditional Korean salads.

name: Taste of Uyghur
description: Authentic Silk Road Uyghur kitchen in Sörnäinen famous for freshly hand-pulled Laghman noodles, savory Gösh Nan flatbreads, steamed manta dumplings, and cumin-spiced grilled lamb skewers.

name: Mashiro Pukinmäki
description: Intimate Japanese restaurant located near Pukinmäki station on Unikkotie, serving freshly prepared sushi platters, steaming ramen, udon noodle bowls, poke bowls, and savory teriyaki dishes.

name: Mashiro Vallila
description: Cozy Japanese eatery situated on Mäkelänkatu in Vallila, offering open-kitchen dining with a wide selection of handmade nigiri, maki rolls, rich noodle soups, donburi rice bowls, and pan-fried gyoza.

name: Olivia Central Station
description: Vibrant Italian restaurant located in the historic former ticket hall of Helsinki Central Railway Station, serving Milanese-inspired wood-fired sourdough pizzas, fresh pasta, antipasti, and quality Italian wines.

name: Vapiano Mikonkatu
description: Spacious, relaxed Italian fast-casual spot on Mikonkatu where chefs prepare customized handmade fresh pasta, crisp stone-baked pizzas, and hearty salads right before your eyes at dedicated cooking stations.

name: Tawook Lab Citycenter
description: Contemporary Syrian eatery in Citykäytävä / Citycenter serving marinated shish tawook chicken platters, spiced kofta, loaded wraps, fresh house-made hummus, and crispy falafel.

name: Tawook Lab Kluuvi
description: Modern Syrian street-food kitchen on the 2nd floor of Kluuvi Shopping Centre featuring charcoal-seasoned tawook skewers, upside-down kofta bowls, batata harra, and vibrant mezze platters.
